title: Epilepsy / EEG Challenges — 30, by difficulty, justified with STAR
note: Each challenge justified in detail using STAR (Situation / Task / Action / Result). Left = challenge; right = STAR detail.

challenges.challenge: Poor electrode contact / high impedance (>10 kΩ)

star.s: Scalp electrodes drift above 10 kΩ during setup, injecting line noise and flat/saturated channels.
star.t: Catch bad contacts BEFORE the recording starts, not after the patient leaves.
star.a: Per-electrode impedance check with a live alert + a pre-recording signal-quality score gate.
star.r: Re-gel before recording → fewer unusable studies, higher downstream model accuracy.

challenges.ai_help: ICA artifact classifier + per-channel artifact heatmap

star.s: Frontal channels carry eye-blinks; temporal channels carry jaw/muscle EMG that mimics fast activity.
star.t: Separate true brain signal from artifact so spikes aren't faked or masked.
star.a: ICA decomposition + an artifact classifier flags components; a per-channel heatmap shows burden.
star.r: Cleaner epochs → fewer false-positive spikes, reviewer trusts the trace.

star.s: Studies arrive without sampling rate, montage, or age — breaking reproducibility and model features.
star.t: Guarantee every study has the metadata AI + audit need.
star.a: Required-field gating at intake + document/EMR auto-extract to pre-fill.
star.r: Complete metadata on every study → reproducible pipeline, no silent feature gaps.

star.s: Patients forget to log events or omit duration/injury, so frequency trends are unreliable.
star.t: Capture every seizure with enough detail to compute trend + severity.
star.a: One-tap mobile entry, auto-severity scoring, and reminder nudges.
star.r: Higher diary completion → trustworthy seizure-frequency trends for the neurologist.

challenges.ai_help: Accelerometer motion detection + flag noisy epochs

star.s: Movement creates large-amplitude transients that masquerade as ictal activity.
star.t: Mark movement-corrupted epochs so they don't pollute analysis.
star.a: Accelerometer/motion channel detects movement and auto-flags the affected epochs.
star.r: Movement epochs excluded → analysis runs on clean signal only.

challenges.challenge: Short routine EEG misses interictal events

star.s: A 20-min routine EEG often captures no epileptiform activity, yielding a false-normal.
star.t: Increase the yield of diagnostic events per recording.
star.a: Protocol guidance: sleep deprivation, prolonged/ambulatory recording, hyperventilation + photic.
star.r: More interictal discharges captured → fewer false-normal studies.

star.s: Devices export 256/512/1024 Hz; models trained at one rate degrade on another.
star.t: Make every recording comparable regardless of source device.
star.a: Pipeline resamples to a canonical rate + records the original in metadata.
star.r: Device-agnostic features → models generalize across machines.

star.s: Swapped or mislabeled channels silently flip localization (left↔right).
star.t: Verify the montage matches the 10-20 standard before analysis.
star.a: Channel-name validation against 10-20 + montage auto-detect with warnings.
star.r: Correct spatial mapping → localization you can trust.

star.s: ASM names/doses are scattered across notes; missing meds break treatment-response analysis.
star.t: Build a complete, current medication list per patient.
star.a: Extract meds from uploaded EMR/PDF + reconcile duplicates.
star.r: Accurate med history → valid adherence + drug-response features.

star.s: Anxious patients tense muscles and move, lowering signal quality.
star.t: Reduce anxiety-driven artifact at acquisition time.
star.a: Calming-protocol checklist + a quality score that prompts a re-take if too noisy.
star.r: Calmer recordings → higher first-pass quality, fewer repeats.

star.s: Two epileptologists disagree on whether a sharp wave is epileptiform.
star.t: Make labels consistent enough to be ground truth for AI.
star.a: Multi-reviewer consensus workflow + Cohen's kappa to quantify agreement.
star.r: Higher inter-rater reliability → trustworthy training labels.

challenges.challenge: Distinguishing artifact from true epileptiform activity
challenges.ai_help: Spike detector w/ morphology + expert loop

star.s: Sharp transients from artifact look like spikes to naive detectors.
star.t: Flag only true epileptiform discharges, not look-alikes.
star.a: Spike detector using morphology features (amplitude/duration/sharpness) + expert validation.
star.r: Lower false-positive spike rate, expert-confirmed labels.

challenges.challenge: Class imbalance — few seizure vs many normal epochs

star.s: Seizures are <5% of epochs; accuracy is misleadingly high while recall is poor.
star.t: Detect the rare seizure class without drowning in normals.
star.a: SMOTE/class-weighting + cost-sensitive, recall-first evaluation.
star.r: Seizure recall rises with controlled false-positive rate.

star.s: Random splits put the same patient's windows in train AND test → inflated accuracy.
star.t: Measure generalization to UNSEEN patients, not memorization.
star.a: GroupKFold by subject + patient-specific temporal split.
star.r: Honest accuracy (0.98 patient-specific vs 0.73 cross-patient) — no leakage.

challenges.challenge: Localizing focal onset zone from scalp EEG

star.s: Scalp EEG blurs the source; pinpointing the focus is hard.
star.t: Produce ranked candidate onset regions for the clinician.
star.a: Band-power topography + graph (GNN) inter-channel connectivity.
star.r: Ranked candidate regions that concord with MRI/semiology.

star.s: EEG findings and observed seizure behavior must agree to be meaningful.
star.t: Quantify how well EEG, MRI, and semiology line up.
star.a: Electroclinical concordance scoring + time-aligned video-EEG.
star.r: A concordance score that strengthens (or questions) the diagnosis.

star.s: Days of video-EEG take hours to review manually.
star.t: Cut reviewer time without missing events.
star.a: AI pre-flags candidate events + summarizes; reviewer confirms.
star.r: Review time drops sharply; reviewer focuses on flagged segments.

challenges.ai_help: Domain adaptation + transfer learning + honest reporting

star.s: A model great on one patient fails on a new patient (distribution shift).
star.t: Close the gap between patient-specific and population models.
star.a: Domain adaptation/transfer learning + report BOTH numbers honestly.
star.r: Stakeholders see the real generalization ceiling — no over-claim.

star.s: Hundreds of band/connectivity features risk overfitting on small cohorts.
star.t: Keep only features that actually carry signal.
star.a: Mutual information + recursive feature elimination + PCA.
star.r: Compact feature set → less overfit, faster, more interpretable.

star.s: Seizure dynamics are spatiotemporal; static features miss evolution.
star.t: Capture how activity evolves across time and channels.
star.a: 1D-CNN / LSTM / Transformer on windowed multi-channel signal.
star.r: Temporal models capture evolution patterns classical features miss.

star.s: Detection says 'seizure now'; patients need warning BEFORE onset.
star.t: Forecast seizure probability with usable lead time.
star.a: Pre-ictal-state models evaluated on sensitivity + lead-time + false-alarm rate.
star.r: Advance warning enables intervention — the thesis novelty over detection.

star.s: DRE (failed ≥2 appropriate ASMs) is recognized late, delaying surgery referral.
star.t: Flag likely DRE candidates as early as possible.
star.a: Model treatment-response trajectory + alert when DRE criteria are met.
star.r: Earlier surgical-evaluation referral for candidates who would benefit.

challenges.challenge: Deep models underperform on small clinical data
challenges.ai_help: Classical 47-feature RF baseline; spectrogram CNN as data grows

star.s: EEGNet (0.72) lost to a 47-feature RandomForest (0.98) on a small cohort.
star.t: Use the model that actually wins for the data size at hand.
star.a: Strong classical baseline now; CNN on spectrograms once data scales — reported honestly.
star.r: Best accuracy for current data + a publishable honest negative result.

challenges.ai_help: SHAP / Grad-CAM vs expert ground-truth + surrogate

star.s: Clinicians won't act on an unexplained score, especially in epilepsy.
star.t: Show WHY the model predicted what it did, in clinical terms.
star.a: SHAP/Grad-CAM compared against expert ground-truth + interpretable surrogate tree.
star.r: Explanations that build clinical trust — core to the governance thesis.

star.s: A model can be accurate overall yet biased against a subgroup.
star.t: Guarantee equitable performance across protected groups.
star.a: Per-subgroup disparate-impact (≥0.8) + equal-opportunity gap (<5%) gates.
star.r: Documented fairness — a deployment prerequisite under AI governance.

star.s: A seizure can strike where there's no connectivity (basement, transit).
star.t: Fire an alert even with zero network.
star.a: On-device edge model + local buffer + sync-on-reconnect + caregiver SOS.
star.r: Alerts that work offline — no missed events due to connectivity.

star.s: Each modality is partial; decisions need them combined.
star.t: Fuse modalities into one coherent assessment.
star.a: Late-fusion ensemble + cross-modal concordance scoring.
star.r: Higher diagnostic confidence than any single modality alone.

challenges.ai_help: Self-supervised pretrain + fine-tune on labeled subset

star.s: Labeled epilepsy data is scarce; training from scratch underperforms.
star.t: Exploit large unlabeled EEG to bootstrap small labeled sets.
star.a: Self-supervised pretraining on unlabeled EEG + fine-tune on the labeled subset.
star.r: Better performance from limited labels — modern transfer approach.

challenges.ai_help: Decision audit rows + HITL override + EU AI Act mapping

star.s: A clinical AI decision must be reproducible, explainable, and overridable.
star.t: Make every AI decision auditable and human-supervised.
star.a: Per-decision audit row (model/prompt version, override, reason) + HITL gate + EU AI Act mapping.
star.r: Regulator-defensible decisions — the heart of the DBA governance thesis.

challenges.ai_help: Federated training + no raw-data egress + secure aggregation

star.s: Hospitals can't share raw EEG/PHI, limiting dataset size.
star.t: Train across institutions without moving patient data.
star.a: Federated training with secure aggregation; only model updates leave each site.
star.r: Larger effective cohort + privacy preserved — no raw-data egress.
